name.zh: 华为原生 Atlas 950 超节点（1,024 NPU）
4 平面 × 两层，radix 1,024，每 NPU 4 × 200G（主算例）
name.en: 4 planes × 2 tiers, radix 1,024, 4 × 200G per NPU (main case)

basis.zh: HC2026：昇腾 960 超节点集群两层 Clos、四平面；星河 UBG 交换机 radix 最高 1,024；附件把它用于 950；950 白皮书允许 2 × 400G UBoE 拆成 4 × 200G
basis.en: HC2026: Ascend 960 SuperPoD clusters use a two-tier, four-plane Clos; Xinghe UBG switches have radix up to 1,024; the attachments apply this to 950; the 950 white paper lets the 2 × 400G UBoE split into 4 × 200G

basis.zh: 950 白皮书 2 × 400G UBoE，每口一个平面
basis.en: 950 white paper 2 × 400G UBoE, one plane per port

name.zh: 2 平面 × 三层，radix 128（51.2T），每 NPU 2 × 400G（HAC-D 模板默认）
name.en: 2 planes × 3 tiers, radix 128 (51.2T), 2 × 400G per NPU (HAC-D template default)

basis.zh: HAC-D a950-ub2 模板默认（综述 2.6 节）；交换机数与券商 UBoE 约 39,000 台同量级
basis.en: HAC-D a950-ub2 template default (survey §2.6); switch count of the order of the broker figure for UBoE (≈ 39,000)

name.zh: 附件方案：每 NPU 1 × 800G，按轨分到 4 个平面，radix 128，按 Clos 自洽所需层数
name.en: the attachments’ scheme: 1 × 800G per NPU, rails spread over 4 planes, radix 128, as many tiers as a Clos needs

basis.zh: 附件写作“两层四平面”、64 口叶 + 128 口脊；每平面 12.8 万个端点时两层 radix 128 只能接 64 × 128 = 8,192 个，须三层
basis.en: the attachments call it “two tiers, four planes” with 64-port leaves and 128-port spines; with 128,000 endpoints per plane two tiers of radix 128 reach only 64 × 128 = 8,192, so three tiers are needed

name.zh: 主算例 + 叶层 2:1 收敛
name.en: main case with 2:1 at the leaves

basis.zh: 附件架构五（推理 PD 分离）的 2:1 收敛，仅作对照
basis.en: the 2:1 of the attachments’ architecture 5 (inference PD disaggregation), for comparison only

superpod.source: Huawei Atlas 950 SuperPoD product page (16 compute + 4 UB interconnect cabinets, ≤ 1,024 NPUs, 64 NPUs + 16 CPUs per cabinet), read 2026-10-19

superpod.rackSwitches.source: UB-Mesh, arXiv 2503.20377 §3.3.1 (72 low-radix switches per reference cabinet of 64 NPUs); Hot Chips 2025 Liao slide 9 (64 + 1 NPUs, 16 CPUs per rack)
superpod.rackSwitches.note: the paper’s reference cabinet applied to the shipped Atlas 950 cabinet (same 8 × 8 NPU mesh)

superpod.podUplinksPerNpu.source: LightCounting 2026-07-21 (128 × 800G OSFP per compute cabinet = 2 per NPU)

superpod.cpusPerNode.source: Huawei Atlas 950 SuperPoD product page: 64 NPUs + 16 Kunpeng 950 per compute cabinet; LightCounting 2026-07-21: 8 NPU trays + 8 CPU trays per cabinet → 16 CPUs / 8 NPU trays = 2 per 8-NPU node
superpod.cpusPerNode.note: reconciled 2026-10-21: the count is vendor arithmetic; which 8 NPUs one CPU failure interrupts (the blast radius of the CPU class) stays an assumption

superpod.podSwitchRadix.source: Hot Chips 2025 Liao slide 9: 128 × 100 Tb/s UB switches in a one-tier Clos for 8,192 NPUs at 2 × 800G per NPU → 16,384 ports / 128 switches = 128 ports × 800G per switch (100 Tb/s / 800 Gb/s = 125 → 128)
superpod.podSwitchRadix.note: reconciled 2026-10-21: was assumed; the radix follows from the slide’s switch count and bandwidth

superpod.transceiversPerLink.source: LightCounting 2026-07-21: 128 × 800G OSFP per compute cabinet (NPU side) and 4,096 modules for 1,024 NPUs including the switch side → 2 links × 2 ends per NPU

scaleOut.source: bandwidth per NPU: Atlas 950 white paper 2 × 400G UBoE, splittable into 4 × 200G (vendor); planes / tiers / radix: by analogy with the Ascend 960 SuperPoD cluster (HC2026: two-tier four-plane Clos, Xinghe UBG radix up to 1,024) as the attachments apply it to the 950
scaleOut.note: reconciled 2026-10-21: was derived; the network design is an analogy, only the per-NPU bandwidth is a stated value

assumed.zh: 每节点 2 CPU：每柜 16 颗鲲鹏 ÷ 8 个 NPU 托盘（厂商数值的算术）；一颗 CPU 故障中断哪 8 张卡（影响域）为假设
assumed.en: 2 CPUs per node: 16 Kunpeng per cabinet ÷ 8 NPU trays (vendor arithmetic); which 8 NPUs one CPU failure interrupts (its blast radius) is assumed

assumed.zh: 每柜 72 片 LRS：UB-Mesh 论文的参考柜数值，套用于量产的 Atlas 950 柜
assumed.en: 72 LRS per cabinet: the UB-Mesh paper’s reference cabinet, applied to the shipped Atlas 950 cabinet

assumed.zh: 超节点层交换 128 × 800G、每超节点 16 台：由 Hot Chips 2025 的 128 台 100 Tb/s 交换机 / 8,192 NPU 推得
assumed.en: pod-tier switches 128 × 800G, 16 per pod: derived from Hot Chips 2025’s 128 × 100 Tb/s switches for 8,192 NPUs

assumed.zh: 每条光链路 2 只光模块：LightCounting 含交换侧共 4,096 只 / 1,024 NPU
assumed.en: 2 transceivers per optical link: LightCounting’s 4,096 modules per 1,024 NPUs including the switch side

assumed.zh: scale-out 主设计 4 平面 × 两层、radix 1,024、每 NPU 4 × 200G：按 960 超节点集群（HC2026）类比；950 白皮书的 2 × 400G UBoE 可拆为 4 × 200G，带宽为厂商值
assumed.en: scale-out main design 4 planes × 2 tiers, radix 1,024, 4 × 200G per NPU: by analogy with the 960 SuperPoD cluster (HC2026); the 950 white paper’s 2 × 400G UBoE split into 4 × 200G, the bandwidth is the vendor value

ubLabel.zh: UB 交换（柜内 LRS + 灵衢互联柜）+ 光链路
ubLabel.en: UB switching (in-cabinet LRS + UB cabinets) + optics

podLabel.zh: 超节点 1,024 NPU：16 计算柜 + 4 互联柜
